messages.author: cd3ad3af7752d717
messages.subject: Trouble with pc.rho1?
parts:
Hi,
 I am trying to use the pc.rho1 prior - but get the error message that the object is not found.
 I have tried this on both the latest stable and training versions of inca on my mac and also get the same error on linux.

 When I look here: https://github.com/andrewzm/INLA/blob/master/R/pc-rho1.R
 I am surprised to see no rho1 functions - it just references cor1
 I was wondering if the wrong file had been uploaded as pc-rho1

 Any other suggestions gratefully received.
Thanks,
Mark

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Trouble with pc.rho1?
parts:
On Wed, 2016-08-17 at 07:51 -0700, Mark Naylor wrote:
> Hi,
>  I am trying to use the pc.rho1 prior - but get the error message
> that the object is not found.
>  I have tried this on both the latest stable and training versions of
> inca on my mac and also get the same error on linux.
>
>  When I look here: https://github.com/andrewzm/INLA/blob/master/R/pc-
> rho1.R
>  I am surprised to see no rho1 functions - it just references cor1
>  I was wondering if the wrong file had been uploaded as pc-rho1
>
>  Any other suggestions gratefully received.
> Thanks,
> Mark

Hi,

the functions are here. its called cor1, not rho1. We changed the name
quite a while ago. 

here is the help page for ?pc.cor1



pc.cor1                  package:INLA                  R Documentation

Utility functions for the PC prior for correlation in AR(1)

Description:

     Functions to evaluate, sample, compute quantiles and percentiles
     of the PC prior for the correlation in the Gaussian AR(1) model
     where the base-model is correlation one.

Usage:

      inla.pc.rcor1(n, u, alpha, lambda)
      inla.pc.dcor1(cor, u, alpha, lambda, log = FALSE)
      inla.pc.qcor1(p, u, alpha, lambda)
      inla.pc.pcor1(q, u, alpha, lambda)
